description: What Tewip is allowed to do to this codebase and what it refuses to do, with the test that enforces each promise named beside it - and how many failures it declined to explain in this project rather than guessing. The page is written by reading those tests off disk, so a promise whose test has been deleted is reported as no longer enforced instead of being repeated. Use it when somebody asks whether this agent is safe to run, what it can touch, or what evidence there is for either answer. No model is called.
